-more- Oct. 27, 2026 ONEOK Announces Higher Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings and Increases 2026 Financial Guidance Record Permian Basin Volumes TULSA, Okla. - Oct. 27, 2026 - ONEOK, Inc. (NYSE: OKE) today announced higher third- quarter 2026 results and increased 2026 financial guidance. Unless otherwise noted, all results are compared with the same period in 2025. Higher Third-Quarter 2026 Results: • Net income of $1.38 billion • Net income attributable to ONEOK of $1.35 billion; $2.13 per diluted share • Adjusted EBITDA of $2.24 billion, up 6% Operational and Strategic Highlights: • 6% increase in NGL raw feed throughput volumes, including a 16% increase in the Gulf Coast/Permian region • 6% increase in refined products volumes shipped • 4% increase in Permian region natural gas volumes processed • Extinguished nearly $5.5 billion of debt principal in September 2026 • Completed $9 billion minority equity investment • Completed the acquisition of Brazos Midstream’s Permian Midland Basin assets • Credit ratings upgraded to BBB+ by S&P Global Ratings and Fitch Ratings 2026 Guidance Increase: • Net income increased to a midpoint of $4.18 billion • Net income attributable to ONEOK increased to a midpoint of $3.985 billion • Earnings per diluted share increased to a midpoint of $6.30 • Adjusted EBITDA increased to a midpoint of $8.55 billion “Higher Permian Basin volumes and the continued execution by our employees to integrate our systems contributed to ONEOK’s third-quarter results,” said Pierce H. Norton II, president and CEO. “Based on this performance and our outlook for the remainder of the year, we are once again raising our 2026 financial guidance, reflecting the momentum we continue to see across the business.” Exhibit 99.1
ONEOK Announces Higher Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings and Increases 2026 Financial Guidance Oct. 27, 2026 Page 2 -more- “As we look to 2027, we expect meaningful earnings growth from our Brazos Permian Midland Basin assets, recently completed and advancing growth projects and continued commercial optimization across our systems,” added Norton. “ONEOK has the assets, financial strength and discipline to capture growing energy demand and deliver sustainable long-term value for investors.” 2026 Guidance: The increase in financial guidance reflects strong year-to-date business performance and volumes, and incorporates expected contributions from the recently completed Brazos Permian Midland acquisition of approximately $75 million, with approximately $50 million expected to be reflected in adjusted EBITDA net of transaction costs. ONEOK increased 2026 net income guidance to a range of $4.09 billion to $4.27 billion. Adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (adjusted EBITDA) guidance increased to a range of $8.5 billion to $8.6 billion. Total 2026 capital expenditure guidance is expected to be approximately $3.5 billion. The update reflects enhanced growth opportunities and capital expenditures related to the Brazos Permian Midland acquisition. THIRD-QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS: Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended Sept. 30, Sept. 30, 2026 2025 2026 2025 (Millions of dollars, except per share amounts) Net income (a) (b) $ 1,384 $ 940 $ 3,127 $ 2,484 Net income attributable to ONEOK (a) (b) $ 1,350 $ 939 $ 3,090 $ 2,416 Diluted earnings per common share (a) (b) $ 2.13 $ 1.49 $ 4.89 $ 3.87 Adjusted EBITDA (c) $ 2,238 $ 2,119 $ 6,356 $ 5,875 Operating income $ 1,568 $ 1,558 $ 4,589 $ 4,209 Operating costs $ 861 $ 738 $ 2,430 $ 2,196 Depreciation and amortization $ 395 $ 378 $ 1,160 $ 1,126 Equity in net earnings from investments $ 103 $ 92 $ 295 $ 281 Maintenance capital $ 162 $ 162 $ 391 $ 362 Capital expenditures (includes maintenance) $ 937 $ 804 $ 2,414 $ 2,182 (a) Amounts for the three and nine months ended Sept. 30, 2026, include a one-time noncash income tax benefit of $336 million, or $0.53 per diluted share, resulting from the ONEOK, Inc. reorganization related to the minority equity transaction. Net income includes $33 million, or $0.05 per diluted share, attributable to noncontrolling interests related to the minority equity investment. (b) Amounts for the nine months ended Sept. 30, 2026, include a pretax noncash charge of $60 million related to the impairment of a joint-venture (JV) investment in the Refined Products and Crude segment. (c) Amounts for the three and nine months ended Sept. 30, 2026, include a $53 million net benefit from the minority equity and Brazos Midland transactions, related primarily to corporate net gains on extinguishment of debt, offset by costs. The three and nine months ended Sept. 30, 2025, include corporate net gains on extinguishment of debt of $22 million and $58 million, respectively, related to open market repurchases. Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP measure used in this release and is explained in greater detail in the Non-GAAP Financial Measures section.
ONEOK Announces Higher Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings and Increases 2026 Financial Guidance Oct. 27, 2026 Page 3 -more- Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Performance: ONEOK reported third-quarter 2026 net income attributable to ONEOK of $1.35 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $2.24 billion. Results benefited from higher natural gas liquids (NGLs), refined products and natural gas volumes and higher optimization and marketing activity. Net income attributable to ONEOK includes a one-time noncash income tax benefit of $336 million resulting from the ONEOK, Inc. reorganization related to the minority equity transaction. In October 2026, ONEOK declared a quarterly dividend of $1.07 per share, or $4.28 per share annualized. BUSINESS SEGMENT RESULTS: Natural Gas Liquids Segment Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended Sept. 30, Sept. 30, Natural Gas Liquids Segment 2026 2025 2026 2025 (Millions of dollars) Adjusted EBITDA $ 718 $ 748 $ 2,083 $ 2,056 Capital expenditures $ 262 $ 218 $ 774 $ 524 The decrease in third-quarter 2026 adjusted EBITDA, compared with third quarter 2025, primarily reflects: • $27 million decrease in exchange services due primarily to: ◦ $45 million decrease from higher inventory of unfractionated NGLs. ◦ $5 million decrease primarily from narrower product price differentials. ◦ $28 million increase from higher volumes, primarily in the Gulf Coast/Permian region. • $27 million decrease from higher operating costs due primarily to $20 million of higher outside services and $7 million of higher employee-related costs associated with the growth of ONEOK’s operations. • $29 million increase in optimization and marketing due primarily to $14 million of higher earnings on sales of purity NGLs held in inventory and $11 million of wider commodity price differentials.
ONEOK Announces Higher Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings and Increases 2026 Financial Guidance Oct. 27, 2026 Page 4 -more- The increase in adjusted EBITDA for the nine-month 2026 period, compared with the same period last year, primarily reflects: • $82 million increase in optimization and marketing due primarily to $60 million of higher earnings on sales of purity NGLs held in inventory and $23 million of wider commodity price differentials. • $41 million decrease from higher operating costs due primarily to: ◦ $19 million decrease from higher employee-related costs. ◦ $14 million decrease from higher outside services. ◦ $8 million decrease from higher property taxes associated with the growth of ONEOK’s operations. • $14 million decrease in transportation and storage due primarily to higher costs and lower volumes. • $2 million decrease in exchange services due primarily to: ◦ $76 million decrease from lower average fee rates and narrower product price differentials in the Gulf Coast/Permian and Mid-Continent regions. ◦ $36 million decrease from higher inventory of unfractionated NGLs. ◦ $35 million decrease from higher transportation and fractionation costs and timing of operational gains and losses. ◦ $146 million increase from higher volumes across ONEOK’s system. Refined Products and Crude Segment Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended Sept. 30, Sept. 30, Refined Products and Crude Segment 2026 2025 2026 2025 (Millions of dollars) Adjusted EBITDA $ 685 $ 582 $ 1,804 $ 1,610 Capital expenditures $ 200 $ 214 $ 571 $ 539 The increase in third-quarter 2026 adjusted EBITDA, compared with third quarter 2025, primarily reflects: • $87 million increase in optimization and marketing due primarily to $67 million of higher liquids blending earnings and $20 million of higher crude marketing earnings. • $36 million increase in transportation and storage due primarily to: ◦ $35 million increase primarily related to favorable margin sharing components within certain crude contracts. ◦ $23 million increase primarily from higher refined products volumes. ◦ $17 million decrease related to the timing of operational gains and losses. • $18 million decrease from higher operating costs due primarily to: ◦ $20 million decrease from higher outside services related to the timing of projects.

The increase in adjusted EBITDA for the nine-month 2026 period, compared with the same period last year, primarily reflects: • $151 million increase in optimization and marketing due primarily to $102 million of higher crude marketing earnings and $49 million of higher liquids blending earnings. • $145 million increase in transportation and storage due primarily to $105 million primarily from higher refined products volumes and $42 million primarily related to favorable margin sharing components within certain crude contracts. • $69 million decrease from higher operating costs due primarily to $27 million of higher employee-related costs associated with the growth of ONEOK’s operations and $24 million of higher outside services related to the timing of projects. • $14 million decrease in adjusted EBITDA from unconsolidated affiliates due primarily to losses on Powder Springs Logistics, a 50%-owned joint venture. • $12 million decrease due primarily to the sale of environmental credits generated by ONEOK’s liquids blending business in 2025. Natural Gas Gathering and Processing Segment Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended Sept. 30, Sept. 30, Natural Gas Gathering and Processing Segment 2026 2025 2026 2025 (Millions of dollars) Adjusted EBITDA $ 563 $ 566 $ 1,576 $ 1,597 Capital expenditures $ 398 $ 302 $ 900 $ 884 The decrease in third-quarter 2026 adjusted EBITDA, compared with third quarter 2025, primarily reflects: • $19 million decrease from higher operating costs due primarily to $11 million of higher outside services related to the timing of projects and $7 million of higher employee-related costs associated with the growth of ONEOK’s operations. • $11 million increase from higher volumes due to increased production in all regions. • $6 million increase due primarily to higher realized condensate and natural gas prices, net of hedging, offset partially by lower realized NGL prices, net of hedging. The decrease in adjusted EBITDA for the nine-month 2026 period, compared with the same period last year, primarily reflects: • $37 million decrease due primarily to lower realized NGL and natural gas prices, net of hedging, offset partially by higher realized condensate prices, net of hedging.

The increase in adjusted EBITDA for the nine-month 2026 period, compared with the same period last year, primarily reflects: • $191 million increase in optimization and marketing activity due primarily to favorable price differentials between the Waha Hub and Katy, Texas, markets. • $60 million increase in transportation services due primarily to higher firm transportation revenue. • $38 million increase in adjusted EBITDA from unconsolidated affiliates due primarily to higher earnings on Northern Border Pipeline and Matterhorn Express Pipeline. • $25 million decrease from higher operating costs due primarily to $12 million of higher employee-related costs associated with the growth of ONEOK’s operations and $9 million of higher outside services related to the timing of projects. LINK TO EARNINGS TABLES AND PRESENTATION: https://ir.oneok.com/financial-information/financial-reports NON-GAAP (GENERALLY ACCEPTED ACCOUNTING PRINCIPLES) FINANCIAL MEASURES: ONEOK has disclosed in this news release adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (adjusted EBITDA), a non-GAAP financial metric used to measure the company’s financial performance. Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net income adjusted for interest expense, depreciation and amortization, noncash impairment charges, income taxes, noncash compensation expense, and other noncash items; and includes adjusted EBITDA from the company’s unconsolidated affiliates using the same recognition and measurement methods used to record equity in net earnings from investments. Adjusted EBITDA from unconsolidated affiliates is calculated consistently with the definition above and excludes items such as interest expense, depreciation and amortization, income taxes and other noncash items. Adjusted EBITDA is useful to investors because it and similar measures are used by many companies in the industry as a measure of financial performance and is commonly employed by financial analysts and others to evaluate ONEOK’s financial performance and to compare the company’s financial performance with the performance of other companies within the industry. Adjusted EBITDA should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for net income or any other measure of financial performance presented in accordance with GAAP. This non-GAAP financial measure excludes some, but not all, items that affect net income. Additionally, this calculation may not be comparable with similarly titled measures of other companies. A reconciliation of net income to adjusted EBITDA is included in the tables available on ONEOK’s website. At ONEOK (NYSE: OKE), we deliver energy products and services vital to an advancing world. We are a leading midstream operator that provides gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation, storage and marine export services. Through our approximately 60,000-mile pipeline network, we transport the natural gas, natural gas liquids (NGLs), refined products and crude oil that help meet domestic and international energy demand, contribute to energy security and provide safe, reliable and responsible energy solutions needed today and into the future. As one of the largest integrated energy infrastructure companies in North America, ONEOK is delivering energy that makes a difference in the lives of people in the U.S. and around the world. ONEOK, Inc. is an S&P 500 company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
